holder-quote: All of it was his Skills. You thought I couldn’t do anything? Niers changed the weather with one of his great Skills.
effect-quote: [Battlefield: Skies of Chaos, Winds of War]. Far more dangerous than [Horrendous Weather]. Some [Strategists] could provoke rain. The Earl of Rains could call thunderstorms.
